# Transcript-archive fixity manifest — snapshot 2026-08-25

The project's session transcripts (the process lab notebook) are preserved in a PRIVATE local
git archive (`~/knowledge-harness-transcripts`, snapshot commit below) per the standing
register's item 13. This repo is private today but publication-intended (plugin, possibly paper), so transcript
bytes never enter its history; this manifest is the citable half of the preservation boundary —
process claims cite a transcript by session id + SHA-256, the bytes stay in the archive (they
carry research content and personal data). 63 files, ~126MB. Sessions live at snapshot time are point-in-time
copies; later snapshots append rows.
